items.title: Astra Studios Launches AstraLabs, Teams with VerSe on AI Pipeline
items.excerpt: The Hombale Group-backed Astra Studios and Dailyhunt parent VerSe will co-develop and market an AI-native pipeline built on SparkStation that carries a production from script to distribution while keeping faces, wardrobe and locations consistent across shots; announced at MIPCOM.

items.title: Animation And VFX Leaders Discuss AI And Jobs At View Conference
items.excerpt: At View Conference, executives from Sony Pictures Imageworks, ILM, Skydance, Cinesite and others discussed shifting pipelines and AI; ILM's Janet Lewin warned against treating AI as a 'magic bullet' while Opsis's Laurens Ehrmann said AI 'can compress execution time, but it cannot compress taste.'

history_match.title: How AI Is Used by Netflix at Its VFX Eyeline Studios, Revealed by VP Mohsen Mousavi at View Conference

items.title: Hollywood Animation Directors On Distribution, Sequels, And AI
items.excerpt: At View, the directors of 'GOAT,' 'Forgotten Island' and 'Toy Story 5' discussed the box office, original storytelling and, unavoidably, AI's place in animation filmmaking.

items.title: Critics Vindicate 'Artificial' After Messy Amazon MGM Breakup (and the Studios vs. Talent Wars Around AI Are Just Beginning)
items.excerpt: Luca Guadagnino's OpenAI drama 'Artificial' earned acclaim after Amazon MGM dropped it; Variety frames it as the opening of a wider studios-vs-talent fight over AI.

items.title: Russell T Davies Calls BBC Boss' AI 'Doctor Who' Comment 'Clumsy' and Teases Show's Future
items.excerpt: Outgoing 'Doctor Who' showrunner Russell T Davies called BBC director-general Matt Brittin's praise of an AI-generated 'Doctor Who' episode 'clumsy,' while confirming new production starts in 2027.

history_match.title: BBC Boss Matt Brittin Says He Was Sent A 'Doctor Who' Episode Entirely Generated By AI

items.title: We Will Never 'Lie To The Audience' Over Artificial Intelligence, Says BBC Content Chief Kate Phillips
items.excerpt: Speaking at MIPCOM after DG Matt Brittin called an AI-generated 'Doctor Who' episode 'pretty good,' BBC content chief Kate Phillips set out the broadcaster's line on AI disclosure, alongside YouTube strategy and 'Blue Planet III.'

items.title: Tsui Hark Pays Emotional Tribute to Nansun Shi, Discusses New Projects and Reflects on AI at Lumière Festival
items.excerpt: At Lumière, Tsui Hark discussed new projects including a London comedy and a dreamlike future city, and the growing challenges for filmmakers in the age of AI.

items.title: Joseph Gordon-Levitt Says Instead of Being Afraid of AI, 'We Should Be Concerned About the People Building AI'
items.excerpt: Joseph Gordon-Levitt warned that AI models are 'being trained to hijack your intimacy,' urging creatives to focus on the companies building the technology.

items.title: Nobody is safe from celebrity AI deepfakes
items.excerpt: Social feeds are filling with AI-generated images of actors and stars, and Meta doesn't require labels for AI-generated still images, leaving performers' likenesses largely unprotected.

items.title: Adobe rebuilt Photoshop and Premiere for NVIDIA's RTX Spark platform
items.excerpt: Adobe has rearchitected Photoshop, Premiere and Substance 3D for NVIDIA's RTX Spark AI superchip, claiming roughly double speed for AI tasks including Premiere's AI-powered editing, effects and color grading.

history_match.title: Adobe Unveils Photoshop Elements and Premiere Elements 2027 With New AI-Powered Capabilities

items.title: Nvidia's Editor's Day: New Windows-based RTX Spark Computers
items.excerpt: Mike McCarthy reports from Nvidia's Editor's Day on how RTX Spark laptops and desktops enable local AI processing for post-production editors and what that shift means for editing workflows.

items.title: Maxon's Fall 2026 Release Brings Bigger Worlds, Faster Workflows, and Major Updates
items.excerpt: Maxon's fall release adds Red Giant Scene Light, an AI-powered depth-aware relighting tool for live-action footage and CG renders after the shoot, plus an MCP server that lets AI agents drive Autograph.
